test_GCSStorageService_read: test the GCSStorageService read method to retrieve file contents from a GCS bucket by URL
test_GCSStorageService_write: test the GCSStorageService write method to upload string data to a GCS bucket object
test_GCSStorageService_copy: test the GCSStorageService copy method to transfer files between local storage and GCS recursively
test_GCSStorageService_upload_dir: test the GCSStorageService upload_dir method to recursively upload a local directory to a GCS bucket
test_GCSStorageService_delete: test the GCSStorageService delete method to remove a file from a GCS bucket by URL
